input.objective: The Hooks Store, phase 2 job 10: free listings and paid #ad placements, after the carry-overs. Read SPEC.md at its current version (1.43, decisions 33 to 36) in https://github.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec, and jobs/job-10-carry-overs.md there (raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/jobs/job-10-carry-overs.md), which holds the full wording, numbers and tests of every carry-over named below. Every carry-over is in scope and is done first. Carry-overs from job 11 (Builder v2, commit e1112f9b): (a) size the hook card's .hc-scroll from its on-screen position, recomputed on scroll (requestAnimationFrame) and resize, never below its load size while the column is stuck; today it collapses to the 140 px floor after any re-render once scrolled (182 to 140 px at 1440x900, 582 to 140 px at 2560x1300); Playwright at both sizes asserts at least the load height and 300 px with the card inside the viewport. (b) below 720 px .hc-scroll is a 64 px window: floor it at 40 percent of the viewport height (the card may run past the first screen); tests at 390x844 and 320x900. (d) the finding excerpt drops its trailing "in the request.". From the first live launches (2448, 2449, 2450 on Robinhood Chain, 2026-10-22): (e) a type A launch goes live from the launch record exactly as B and C do (artifacts by role hook, token, distributor; status live when the record is live and the hook has code; the pool id keccak256 of the ABI-encoded seeded PoolKey, prefilled in the pool selector), because IMD's result file carries no address and launch 2448 (request 0xece8c70d612890553921a16cfbf19b2c674937735f78591743476d8b3ff3bd5c) shows "In progress" with every address "unknown until live" although TestHook 0x5a9e7a61c45d2c615162fa57931bcbc06d9b20cc, TestToken 0xe7244bfb99c7ad49c5a40eaeedb215cb47dde85b and the seeded TEST/IMD pool (id 0xccab6575b5cdd5798731f62f9299c442f954366e91b9513386d83e249cb99843) are on chain; unit tests on evidence/launch-5-launch-live.json and a Playwright case for a type A page reaching Live. From a proven launch, usually less."; (11) from the ads audit: never render a cancelled or expired placement even when featured() lists it, page past them, the BOOST confirmation sentence, totals from rankOf; (12) controls before a pool exists (decision 33): "No pool uses this hook yet. Open a pool with it, or enter its pool id above." with Send disabled, the pool selector fed by the PoolManager's Initialize events filtered by hook plus a typed id, every Send simulated first with the catalog's plain reason on a revert, management rows built from the contract's ABI at the source commit (out/<Name>.sol/<Name>.json from raw.githubusercontent.com, catalog signatures as fallback) so launch 2424 keeps working; Playwright for a hook-only page with no pool and the 2424 ABI. Then the job itself: implement SPEC.md sections 3.1 (featured carousel) and 6.6 against the deployed contracts, live since 2026-10-22: Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663, launch 2454, https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2454-what-build-two-immutable at commit 952e62de284440144a24fc4ec4868461e4534612) HookListingRegistry 0x366c84a2971713fc8fa24d3d4b8abd2f4f085625 and FeaturedPlacementsV2 0x63b59cbf5b535e46815ae5d4cf126bf409dba69c; Ethereum (chain id 1, launch 2456, https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2456-what-build-two-immutable at commit fcca6490b279cd9821cf71d1edf083afbfa1cba5) HookListingRegistry 0xff8b7110525c1ec39d6df825880890e7d9184f06 and FeaturedPlacementsV2 0x1da6f19ee08365813651de6420603fea4fbcdc9a. Put them into public/site-config.json as an "ads" map keyed by chain id (registry, placements, launchNumber, commit) and the ABIs from those repositories at those commits under src/abi; a chain whose addresses are missing shows neither the strip nor the Promotions panel. Featured strip: read featured(1, 100) with each placement total, getPlacement for each active id, getListing and getMetadata at the pinned revision; one-line cards (#AD pill, name, symbol, by creator as ENS name or shortened payer address, hours left) in the self-scrolling strip, sorted by total paid with ties by lower id, open-slot card last, refreshed every 60 seconds, no buttons. Promotions panel in My hooks per SPEC 3.5: the wallet's placements with hours left, total paid, rank, BOOST (ask an amount, deposit if needed, boost(id, amount)) and CANCEL. Promote a hook: for a live hook the connected wallet launched, a four-step flow with real wallet transactions: createListing in HookListingRegistry (chainId, hook address, metadata from the hook page: name, source and audit links, the callback mask from the address bits, the fee and admin disclosures from the blocks), approve and deposit 0.1 IMD into FeaturedPlacementsV2, purchase(listingId, revision, proceedsRecipient read live, deadline now + 10 minutes) for 24 hours, a done state linking to the carousel. Also cancel with the pro-rata base refund and forfeited boosts explained, withdraw the available balance, and the hook page's #ad state while a placement is active. Tests: an Anvil fork with both contracts deployed from the pinned build runs listing, deposit, purchase, boost from a second wallet, cancel and withdraw end to end and asserts the carousel shows the pinned revision after an edit; Playwright for the flow at three widths. Deliver source, dist/ and test results.
